title: Vanishing integrals over all rational subintervals force a.e. vanishing
statement: Let c, d be real numbers and let w : ℝ → ℝ be Lebesgue-integrable on (c, d). If ∫_{(p,q)} w(α) dα = 0 for all rational numbers p, q with c < p < q < d, then w vanishes almost everywhere on (c, d): for almost every α ∈ ℝ, α ∈ (c, d) implies w(α) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (c d : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), IntegrableOn w (Ioo c d) → (∀ p q : ℚ, c < (p : ℝ) → (p : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) → (q : ℝ) < d → ∫ α in Ioo (p : ℝ) (q : ℝ), w α = 0) → ∀ᵐ α, α ∈ Ioo c d → w α = 0
